Container.Name: filesystem-mcp
Container.Overview: MCP filesystem server with Streamable HTTP transport (community wrapper around the official MCP filesystem server). Exposes directories to AI clients (Claude Desktop, Code) as MCP file tools. Tailscale sidecar variant -- REQUIRES a sidecar named exactly tailscale-filesystem-mcp deployed first.
Container.Requires: **CRITICAL: A Tailscale sidecar container named EXACTLY `tailscale-filesystem-mcp` must be deployed BEFORE this template will start.** Deploy the generic tailscale-sidecar template first, but rename the container from the default `tailscale-sidecar` to `tailscale-filesystem-mcp` and rename the state path accordingly. This container shares the sidecar's network namespace via `--network=container:tailscale-filesystem-mcp`. See docs/TAILSCALE_SIDECAR_GUIDE.md.
Container.Description:
Wraps the official MCP filesystem server (modelcontextprotocol/servers) with Streamable HTTP transport (SHTTP). The official server speaks stdio only; this community wrapper exposes it over HTTP so the Tailscale sidecar pattern can carry the traffic.
Exposes mounted directories as MCP file tools (read, write, list, move, search). Shares the network namespace of a Tailscale sidecar -- no ports published to host.
============================================================ REQUIRED RENAME BEFORE DEPLOYMENT ============================================================ The tailscale-sidecar template ships with default container name `tailscale-sidecar`. This filesystem-mcp template references `Container:tailscale-filesystem-mcp`. You MUST rename the sidecar container (and its state path) to `tailscale-filesystem-mcp` before deploying this template, OR edit the Network field of this template to match the actual name of your sidecar. ============================================================
Mount at least one host directory under /projects/ inside the container. The container will exit if /projects/ is empty.
Upstream image source: https://github.com/mekayelanik/filesystem-mcp

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Primary directory to expose via MCP. Must be a subdirectory of /projects/ inside the container. The container exits if /projects/ is empty. Add more Path entries to expose additional directories (e.g., /projects/wiki, /projects/notes).

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Internal HTTP port for MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint. Accessible via Tailscale sidecar IP at this port.

Config.Name: Protocol
Config.Description: Transport protocol. SHTTP (Streamable HTTP) is recommended. Also supports SSE and WS.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID. Default 99 (nobody) is correct for Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID. Default 100 (users) is correct for Unraid.

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Allowed CORS origins. Use * for development, restrict in production.
